messages:
tess_oncall: Heads-up — GreyBox on dedicated pool eu-west-2-gb1 reporting repeated scale-up/down churn for ~30m, causing intermittent 429s and a noticeable billing bump. Repro I ran: spike 50 parallel small gen requests for 5s every 10s. Autoscaler flips every ~2m. Logs:

```
2026-03-17T10:00:12Z autoscaler INFO scale_up +2 target=8 reason=cpu_spike
2026-03-17T10:02:09Z autoscaler INFO scale_down -2 target=6 reason=queue_empty
2026-03-17T10:04:11Z proxy WARN 429 route=/v1/generate client=greybox-frontend
```

Also saw a short burst of 401s around 10:03 but not sure if client-side. Putting this here so triage folks can grab logs + repro steps. Anyone able to check metrics & possible noisy neighbor?

maya_support: Thanks — can you confirm if the 401s are auth failures (invalid token) or 401 from throttling gateway? Customer said they rotated keys earlier today. I'll flag billing if we confirm overage due to retries.

alex_sre: Pulling metrics now. CPU and request_queue_length show sawtooth aligned with your spikes. I see one host in the same pool with very high tail-latency (p95 450ms -> 1.2s) during bursts — that could be a noisy tenant causing autoscaler reflexes. The 401s look like client-side token refresh failing (their SDK logs show 401 then immediate retry). Retries + oscillation = billing bump. Suggest: temporarily raise autoscale cooldown to 240s and enable smoothing window (3m) for this pool, and add a tenant cap to avoid single-tenant driving scaling.

liam_prodeng: +1 on cooldown and tenant cap. We have a small in-flight change to enable stable-target mode for dedicated pools to avoid aggressive downscales; I can expedite a canary. Need eng-platform thumbs up to apply to eu-west-2-gb1.

sre-bot: action queued: autoscale-cooldown-tuning -> canary deploy to eu-west-2-gb1 (owner: alex_sre). CI passed.

alex_sre: Starting canary now. Running local load repro with: `./tools/loadest --pool eu-west-2-gb1 --tenant greybox --qps 50 --burst` — will watch metrics and post results in ~15m :eyes:

maya_support: I opened billing ticket #3421 to flag potential invoice credit pending investigation. Also asked GreyBox to verify token rotation logs on their side.

tess_oncall: Thanks team — if canary stabilizes p95 and eliminates 429s, escalate to full rollout. If not, we'll isolate suspect host and evict tenant for mitigation.
